d:
Are you getting enough protein after 40? As we age, our bodies become less responsive to the muscle-building effects of protein. This is known as anabolic resistance. Adequate protein intake, combined with regular strength-building activity, helps maintain muscle mass, strength and mobility.
In this video, Hansaji explains how much protein healthy adults may need after 40 and how to meet these requirements through simple, affordable vegetarian Indian foods.
You will learn about:
1. How to estimate your daily protein requirement based on body weight.
